title: Total knee arthroplasty with the enovis™ Dual-Pivot™ articulation EMPOWR 3DTM cemented knee system: A single centre, single arm non-interventional cohort study with clinical and radiological outcomes.
summary:
The study is performed to gain more data on safety and performance of the
CE-certified EMPOWR Knee systems when used as intended and placed with guided instruments. The study takes place at one site in Germany, all patients received une of the EMPOWR knee systems. The surgery already took place 2 years (+/-3 Months) ago and patients willing to participate in the study will be followed up including a physical evaluation (physical performance test, knee stability, Range of motion) and assessment of validated scores for patient satisfaction, QoL and pain.
conditions: Joint replacement /artificial knee due to degeneration, necrosis, fracture etc

interventions.name:
A Primary total knee arthroplasty (TKA) using EMPOWR 3D knee
system was done 2 years (± 3 months) ago. In agreement with the medical standard demographics and medical history were collected and a physical examination of the 
Knee was performed. 
Prospectively, 1 visit will be done, including the

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Primary total knee arthroplasty (TKA) using EMPOWR 3DTM knee
system 2 years (± 3 months).
• The patella has not been replaced.
• Candidates for knee arthroplasty as per the indication for use from
the manufacturer.
The EMPOWR 3DTM knee system is indicated for disability due to:
o degenerative, post-traumatic or rheumatoid arthritis
o avascular necrosis of the femoral condyle
o post-traumatic loss of joint configuration, particularly when there
is patellofemoral erosion, dysfunction or prior patellectomy
o moderate valgus, varus or flexion deformities
o treatment of fractures that are unmanageable using other
techniques.
• The EMPOWR 3D™ system has been implanted according to the
manufacturer’s instructions.
• The patient has provided written informed consent.
• The patient agrees that the data already collected may be used in the
context of this study.
• The patient agrees to participate in the above-mentioned follow-up
examination.
• The patient has a functional understanding of the German language
(used in the questionnaires).
Exclusion criteria:
•TKA at contralateral site
• Secondary surgery performed as a result of previously failed surgical
attempts.
• Patient was <18 years of age at the time of the surgery.
• The patella was replaced.
• Patient was contraindicated at the time of arthroplasty as per
instructions for use from the manufacturer. 
Contraindications include:
o infection (or a history of infection), acute or chronic, local or
systemic;
o insufficient bone quality which may affect the stability of the implant;
o muscular, neurological or vascular deficiencies, which compromise
the affected extremity;
o obesity;
o alcoholism or other addictions;
o materials sensitivity;
o untreated medial and lateral ligamentous instability
o high levels of physical activity (e.g., competitive sports, heavy
physical labour).
• Patient is unwilling or unable to provide consent.
• Patient may have a cognitive disorder or condition that does not allow
the patient to consent to the study.
• Patient is contraindicated for radiographic diagnostic imaging as per
institute policy (e.g., pregnant women, or unconfirmed possibility for
pregnancy, patients exposed to high radiation burden previously).
• Patient is unable or suspected to be unable to comply with study
procedures (e.g., drug or alcohol abuse, transportation restrictions,
dementia)
• Patient has a manifestation of osteoporosis or tumours affecting the
implant, between the date of surgery and study enrolment.
• Patient is already participating in another clinical study that may
impact the current study.
• Patient is a prisoner at the time of inclusion
• Patient has an acute or chronic, local or systemic infections, not
related to the implant.
• Patient presents with conditions not related to the implant that may
influence the outcome of a subjective pain/QoL assessment
(depression, other illness, etc.)
• Patient has muscular, neurological or vascular deficits of the affected
limb
• Patient has a BMI > 40 developed after arthroplasty
• Patient participates in high physical activity (e.g., competitive sports,
heavy physical labour) after TKA.
• Patient is a relative of the investigator or of the device manufacturer
(Mathys Ltd / Enovis / Encore Medical, L.P.).
• Patient is an employee of the site or the device manufacturer (Mathys
EMP2024, Version 1.0 of date 01.11.2024 Page 12 of 49
Ltd / Enovis / Encore Medical, L.P.).
• Patient is unable to understand the German language (used in
questionnaires)
